warmup.mindset: 60 seconds, eyes closed or soft focus. Name today's goal out loud.
warmup.mobility: Hip circles, leg swings (front/side), ankle rolls
warmup.activation: Kneel-to-stand hip drive reps, then pogo hops (priming the front kick)
warmup.stance: Weighted low lunge hold, 1 minute: tall posture, knees hover an inch or less off the floor. Go straight into form stances.

sparring.conditioning: High-low round kicks, 20 sec each leg. Record your count.
sparring.noContact: Free sparring, continuous rather than point based.

seg3.label: Forms — In Wha 1
seg3.detail: Move 19: R Square Block after the 270 degree clockwise spin. The same spin returns at move 32. Teach the square block, then the spin, then put them together. Individual practice. Group 2 (new to In Wha 1, moves 1-18): speed on kick pairs 7–8 and 16–17.

seg4.label: Board Break
seg4.detail: Front kick the target, hold the knee up for a count of 1001 before stepping down.
seg4.note: Board level is individualized: the student's own size and ability. Level up only after 3 consecutive first-try breaks. Any miss means stay at the current board.

seg5.label: Self-Defense — Body Lock and Bear Hug
seg5.detail: Shadow Monster in pairs, 60-second turns. The shadow body-locks or bear-hugs. Defender scores 1 for turning and squaring up with arms up, 1 for breaking the arms and escaping. Shadow scores when the defender loses balance and a hand or knee touches the floor. No technique is taught yet. Match partners by size and strength.

dailyChallenge.standard: Rep counts each time a knee drives to the chest. Hands under shoulders, hips level, no piking.
dailyChallenge.phase: Baseline test: establish your own starting number

seg3.label: Self-Defense — Body Lock and Bear Hug
seg3.detail: Two hands against one. Attack the exposed thumb of the top hand: palm over the thumb, fingers wrap to the back of the pinky, pry up and press down like a dip so the wrist bends in like a gooseneck. Once one hand breaks free there is room to escape.

seg4.label: Forms — In Wha 1
seg4.detail: Moves 29–31: L #1 Outer Crescent Kick with a 180 degree turn → R Outer Knifehand Block → L Punch. Pivot the heel back toward where the foot lands, look over the shoulder, raise the leg, and let the body draw the rainbow. Land in a middle stance. Group 2 (new to In Wha 1, moves 1-18): speed on the inner crescent kicks (moves 3 and 12).
